name: What factors should I consider when choosing a contractor for window framing?

mainEntity.name: What factors should I consider when choosing a contractor for window framing?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing a contractor for window framing, consider their experience with structural modifications and window installations, especially in your local area. Verify they are licensed and insured in California, and ask for references or examples of similar past projects. Look for a contractor who clearly communicates the process, provides a detailed quote, and understands local building codes in places like Pacifica or San Bruno. A good contractor will ensure the framing is structurally sound, square, and prepared correctly for your chosen windows, impacting both the performance and longevity of your new windows.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a contractor with proven experience in structural modifications and window framing, ensuring they are licensed, insured, and knowledgeable about local Bay Area building codes. Check references and review detailed quotes.
